qti-item-body.p: A reading item asks the student to select the author's claim inside a short paragraph.

qti-hottext-interaction.qti-prompt: Read the paragraph and select the phrase that best states the author's claim.
qti-hottext-interaction.p: The city should convert the vacant lot on Pine Street into a pocket park. A small green space would give nearby residents a shaded place to gather, and volunteers have already offered to maintain native plants. The lot is 0.4 acres and sits next to a bus stop. The planning department posted the proposal last Tuesday. Two benches are stored in a public works warehouse.
